notes.title: Game Update - March 27
notes.content:
在上周五的版本更新中我们着重对跳跃操作部分进行的优化，目前游戏中已经修复了同时按方向键与跳跃键会导致跳跃无法触发的问题，并且调整了跳跃的触发判定现在大家可以更容易的进行连续跳跃与平台边缘起跳操作。

本次更新中会为游戏初期加入引导提示能够帮助大家在游戏初期能够更好的理解游戏机制。

最后我们希望体验过更新版本后的小伙伴来分享一下感受，如果对于目前游戏还有任何希望改进的部分或建议也欢迎大家多多分享，同时也感谢一直以来的包容与反馈，我们会努力持续完善游戏体验的。
  
[b]更新具体内容如下[/b]：
[olist]
[*] 优化循环关卡，去除不必要的死亡区域。
[*] 修复竹林变身关卡，弹床箱子掉落后，角色死亡或者传送回来，无法推动的问题。
[*] 调整竹林爬绳子跳跃到平台的操作容错。
[*] 优化皇宫密室机关设计。
[*] 修复葬剑域和混沌之地特殊弹床机关特殊操作下角色没有进行正常远距离跳跃的问题。
[*] 修复箱子推下去会消失的BUG。
[*] 修复葬剑域石头人追击关卡，特殊操作下可以同时规避滚石和石头人的问题。
[*] 修改随机鼎关卡，鼎和提示不匹配的情况。
[*] 修复悬挂起身的时候，地面如果消失，无法立刻下落的问题。
[*] 优化新手引导。
     a)开场动画结束后，会出现对话的引导。
     b)接了村口守门人任务后，等待10秒，出现跳跃引导。
     c)村口守门人交任务后，会立刻出现地图引导。
     d)解救瑾剧情，10秒后会出现解绳子的交互引导。
     e)第一个梯子处20秒没爬，会出现爬梯子引导。
     f)玄入队后，出现变身引导。10秒后出现推树的交互引导。
     g)乌龟后第一个石头，30秒后，会出现推箱子交互引导。
     h)拽藤蔓处梯子，40秒后出现爬梯子引导。
     i)拽藤蔓处，45秒后会出现拽藤蔓交互引导。
     j)光合作用机关，90秒后会出现拉花盆引导。
     k)水池机关，每8秒会出现插剑和闸门共3处，流光交互引导。
     l)黑土地关卡，20秒没发现箱子会出现引导，之后每8秒出现一次流光。
     m)木架子机关，10秒后会出现主动悬挂引导。
[*] 洞口法阵关卡，概率性卡关问题。
[*] 修复获取萤火虫后脱离一定范围，萤火虫材质消失的问题。
[*] 修复皇宫放水浮箱关卡，复活后拉箱子脱手的问题。[/olist]

如有遇到其他问题，欢迎加入BUG反馈群：1043513897 进行反馈。
如果在游戏过程中遇到解谜上的难题，也可以加入官方交流群：239656132和其他玩家们一起讨论哦~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34730740/82e2dcfb4effb693b4bb0b998ee369bd798508a0.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Update - March 20
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes [/h3]
Dear players, in this update we've still focused on optimizing sticky movements that may disturb the characters go/jump smoothly in the previous version. Luckily we've managed to make sure the whole movement (including jumping) experience is much more fluently than ever. Moreover, we've optimized the puzzles (including jump puzzles) and added more hints.

We appreciate your understanding and patience. 
Please let us know if you encounter any issues and we'll do our best to improve the gameplay experience as much as possible. 
[list]
[*] Advanced adjustments on character movements.
[*] Optimized numerous puzzles and mechanical triggers.
[*] Fixed some issues while connecting to the Xbox controller.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34730740/dd535e340624104b5338bb9e8378a473dfec7502.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Update - March 14
notes.content:
[h3]Patch Notes [/h3]
Dear players, in this update we've fixed several fatal loading issues and optimized sticky movements that may disturb the characters go/jump smoothly in the previous version. 
[list]
[*] Advanced adjustments on character movements.
[*] Better timing of auto-save checkpoints.
[*] Optimized several puzzles and mechanical triggers.
[*] Fixed portal transportation failure after revival.
[*] Fixed some crashes caused by graphic cards or other hardware.
[/list]
We appreciate your patience and wish you enjoy the unique platformer experience in Bright Bird.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34730740/dd535e340624104b5338bb9e8378a473dfec7502.jpg[/img]

notes.title: China s indie scene is flourishing, so here are 6 Chinese indie games to look out for in 2020
notes.content:
In December 2019, China s indie scene was out in full force at WePlay in Shanghai, arguably the most significant developer-focused event in the country. Paired with the China Indie Game Alliance (CiGA) conference, the annual convention is a highlight for the mainland s relatively young game scene.

Chinese heavyweights like Next Studios, TapTap, bilibili, and Coconut Island held court on the floor the latter had a booth styled as a nostalgic classroom with a blackboard and wooden desks. There were also, of course, international names like Blizzard, Ubisoft, and 505 Games. But the real stars of the show were from smaller studios, each offering an intriguing look at the range and depth of the Chinese indie landscape.
